title: Quality — Supreme Art
description: Documented quality assurance across every stage of pharmaceutical carton production — from incoming board to final inspection, with full batch traceability.

commitment.heading: Built for pharma standards.
commitment.text: Medicine packaging doesn't get second chances. We run documented quality assurance across every stage of production, with full batch traceability — so what leaves our floor is exactly what you approved.

process.heading: Quality checks at every stage.
process.intro: From incoming paperboard to the cartons released for delivery, our QC team records and verifies the details that protect every product, print run and customer approval.

steps.title: Incoming board inspection
steps.text: Before printing begins, every paperboard batch is checked for grammage, thickness, surface condition and overall quality.

steps.title: Shade card approval
steps.text: A reference shade card is prepared for every product and approved before the final printing run is released.

steps.title: Printing quality control
steps.text: During printing, our QC team uses a colour spectrophotometer to verify colour shades while also checking registration and text content against the approved proof.

steps.title: Coating inspection
steps.text: Applied finishes, including UV and spot UV coatings, are checked for coverage, alignment, consistency and the required appearance.

steps.title: Conversion checks
steps.text: After die-cutting, breaking and folder gluing, cartons are checked for dimensions, crease quality, clean edges and secure pasting.

steps.title: Final inspection & release
steps.text: Finished cartons receive a final quality inspection. Approved packs are identified with QC status stickers before they are cleared for delivery.

cta.heading: Packaging you can rely on.
cta.text: Talk to us about your quality requirements and we'll show you how we meet them.
